dataset: synthetic drilling telemetry — rate of penetration (ROP) modelling

flow_per_rpm.meaning: Mud flow per revolution — hole-cleaning capacity at the current rotary speed.

specific_energy.meaning: Torque times rotary speed — proxy for mechanical specific energy at the bit.

torque_per_wob.meaning: Torque per unit weight on bit — friction and formation response indicator.

wob_per_depth.meaning: Weight on bit normalised by depth, so deep and shallow readings compare fairly.

depth_ft.meaning: Measured depth of the bit at the time of the reading.

mud_flow_gpm.meaning: Drilling-mud flow rate through the drill string.

rop_ft_hr.meaning: Rate of penetration — how fast the bit advances through rock.

rpm.meaning: Rotary speed of the drill string.

torque_klbf_ft.meaning: Rotary torque on the drill string.

well_id.meaning: Identifier of the well the reading belongs to.

wob_klbf.meaning: Weight on bit — downward force applied to the drill bit.

note: Synthetic, seeded data only. No real well, rig, or production data.
